name: Deterministic permissions layer for coding agents

mentions.name: Deterministic permissions layer for coding agents
mentions.description: A deterministic permissions layer for coding agents that works like auto-mode for Claude Code: users stay in the flow and are prompted to allow or deny tool calls only when it truly matters. A rule-based classifier auto-allows or blocks 95% of Bash tool calls as safe or dangerous, leaving only the remaining 5% as ambiguous. Agent autonomy is governed through policies stored at the user and repo level, and the tool saves tokens compared with LLM-based auto modes.
mentions.problem: LLM-based permission auto-review modes (Claude's auto mode, Codex auto review) are overkill for classifying most Bash tool calls and waste tokens, like using a data center to flip a light switch.
mentions.source_excerpt: A better permissions layer for coding agents. The tool works like auto-mode for Claude Code, so you can stay in the flow and only get prompted to allow or deny tool calls when it truly matters, but it is fully deterministic.
